existing_diagram_checks.result: All source-authored TikZ diagrams were checked against their source-described maps and relations. They render correctly. No additional high-likelihood diagram omission was identified; remaining algorithmic or theorem content is adequately specified by its formulas and prose.

review_summary.notes: All frozen source snapshots match both the assigned SHA256 and the current local item files; all assigned HTML hashes match. Every receipt-listed tile was individually opened at original resolution and its hash and dimensions recorded. Tiles were treated individually, including overlapping boundaries.

limitations: Read-only frozen snapshot and local HTML review; no HTTP/live website access was used.
This review covers rendered notation, title fidelity, authored diagrams, and high-likelihood missing diagrams; it is not an independent proof audit.
